name: webiny-new-entry-wizard
description: Building a New Entry Wizard for the Headless CMS. Use this skill when the developer wants to show a custom wizard UI before the entry form when creating new CMS entries -- collecting fields like title, slug, or category upfront, then pre-filling the entry form. Covers ContentEntryEditorConfig.NewEntryWizard, createFeature, FormModelFactory, createReactiveComponent, useContentEntryFormPresenter, and the dirty-flag on setData.
